title: Teen Micro-Camp Swap Board
oneLiner: Parents of older kids pool half-day activities, host rotations, and pickup coverage when normal camps vanish or cost too much.
targetUser: Working parents with kids 12+ who are too old for many camps but not ready to be unsupervised all summer.
keyUx: Build a parent pod schedule, list trusted hosts and paid mini-activities, balance pickups, and create a weekly safety/contact sheet.
stitchPrompt: Create a responsive planning app called “Teen Micro-Camp Swap Board” for parents of older kids who lack affordable summer camp options. Show a teen availability grid, parent host rotation, paid mini-activity cost rows, pickup coverage, emergency contact sheet, behavior and screen-time pact, and weekly swap receipt. Design direction: use the calm-consumer profile with warm practical planning surfaces, readable family schedules, low-stress warning states, and clear share/export controls.
